entries.not_relevant_because: The list bullet asks for the possible configurations of the connected components of M-curves, i.e. the first part of Hilbert's sixteenth problem for nonsingular real plane curves of maximal component count, with realisation and exclusion for every degree n. Both manuscripts concern only the second part, limit cycles of planar polynomial vector fields. 'Uniform bounds for planar polynomial limit cycles' proves that a degree-dependent bound B(d) on limit cycles exists, and 'Two limit cycles for quintic Lienard systems' shows that one Lienard family has at most two cycles, with the bound attained. Neither mentions real algebraic curves, M-curves, ovals or nests, or the arrangement of their components. The word 'components' in the uniform-bounds text refers to fibres of an analytic map in the proof, and 'ovals' appears only in a cited result on Hamiltonian ovals and limit cycles. The family's bearing is on the separate second-part question (a finite bound H(n) on limit cycles), which the problem_asks says is recorded as a different question, not on this bullet.
